title: Cleartext http:// URL (universal) — review required
description: Code references a cleartext HTTP URL: http://[A-Za-z0-9]. Traffic to it is readable and modifiable by network observers. This lexical rule flags the literal; the reviewer confirms the endpoint is non-sensitive or upgrades it.
remediation: Use the https:// equivalent (the https:// equivalent); keep http only for non-sensitive local endpoints with a comment.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the scheme regardless of endpoint sensitivity.
